description: List test scripts for a project, optionally filtered by test case and by environment lane. Returns up to 10 items per page by default (max 100). Response includes pagination metadata (totalCount, totalPages, hasMore) — check `hasMore` to decide whether to fetch additional pages.

page.description: Page number, 1-based. Defaults to 1 (the first page).

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 10, max 100.

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) to list test scripts for

runEnvironmentType.description: Environment lane for the run: 'local' (developer localhost) or 'remote' (deployed). Selects which versioned runSettings/credentials lane the cloud resolves. Omit for remote (default).

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to createdAt (stable under concurrent writes).

sortOrder.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc (newest first).

testCaseId.description: Optional test case ID (UUID) to filter scripts by

name: muggle-remote-test-script-list
